The city will rise from the ashes

Well, I'm gonna be depressed yet again. So much beautiful architecture gone...just look at the ol' Hot Dog War Memorial on the corner...beautiful building there in the early 1900's, now it's just a blocky...red thing.

The Adventure Center - really, they couldn't have retained the original window frames? Y'know, the ones that added character? Let's just brick it up and put in standard square ones, fuck it.

I've seen a lot of this happen over the course of the years - at least when shit isn't getting burned down or scrapped, and it's kinda heartbreaking.

No one's building stuff with that kind of character any more. How many fucking boxes with aluminum and giant windows does an area need? I'll wager much of today's 'architecture' is going to be as dated and disposable as some of the goofy shit from the 60's and 70's.

As a final note, look at...I believe the first picture - tons of small businesses back then, now you get fuckin' Rent-A-Center and the like. Without stuff like that, might as well let the city burn down...because Rent-A-Center sure as hell isn't going to reinvest in the area with its profits and paychecks.
